evidence.model: Uncalibrated dry contact thermal/geometry screening; no material qualification

contact.notes: E and mu are unmeasured scenario inputs, not temperature-specific properties; equal load allocation is imposed, not predicted.

thermal.notes: k=.4 is indicative TIVAR1000 at23C; use at50C is an assumption. Cvol=930*2000: density930 reference, cp2000 assumed. Grain conductivity equal-base is hypothetical. No phase change, water, roughness spectrum, finite-grain solution or nonlinear softening.

layout.notes: Four possible caps in square, not a manufactured or stable-load-bearing full grain. Uniform heat flux; all heat to moving base; no transverse spreading for pulse comparison.

budget.note: Inherited pretax hypothetical envelope, not a quote; 2% is a purchased replacement assumption, never an environmental release allowance. Equipment tax-inclusive JPY200M requirement is separate and unproven.

cost.notes: Hypothetical processing/material premiums, fixed mass. Any extra mass, density, yield loss, equipment and reprocessing must be added. Not supplier prices.
